task: Reconcile diverse observational methods to produce 2000–2023 annual regional and global glacier mass change time series with uncertainties in m w.e. and Gt using the GlaMBIE dataset.
named_commitments: Use GlaMBIE dataset as primary data source
Cover 19 global glacier regions and global aggregate
Express results in both specific mass change (m w.e.) and total mass change (Gt)
Address observational-method reconciliation across glaciological, DEM differencing, altimetry, gravimetry, and hybrid/combined inputs
Provide validation/comparison plots and benchmark framing

planned_implementation.primary_source: Use published GlaMBIE result files for consensus regional/global annual calendar-year series; inspect input files to characterize method coverage and heterogeneity.
analysis_scope: method coverage/comparison diagnostics from input and hydrological files
limitations_to_check: Whether 2023 means interval 2023.0–2024.0 in provided calendar-year files
Whether exact original reconciliation algorithm can be rerun from inputs alone or is represented via published result files
